training.label_source: Per-read LDX barcode call from barcode_crf_nbc16_rna004@v0.3.0, mapped to class by datasets.yaml:label_by_code -- ldx01-10 charged, ldx11-16 uncharged. The caller's error rate is the label-noise floor. The groups are enrichments, not purities: ldx06-10 is spiked and measures ~80% charged by an independent marker, and deacylation during prep converts charged -> uncharged. The operating point in the metrics does NOT rest on these labels; it is derived from ligation chemistry on the two pure blocks.
training.dataset: 20260814_charged_vs_uncharged: E. coli K-12 MG1655 tRNA, 16 LDX codes on a single shared edx07 3' adapter, the same pool on two flowcells (Rep_1 PBK76952 train/val, Rep_2 PBK76980 test). Charging varies WITHIN each flowcell, which is what makes a cross-experiment test a generalisation axis rather than a batch measurement. The same physical run as ldx16_charging_20260814; only the basecaller differs.
training.pipeline: dorado 2.1.1 rna004_sup@v6.0.0 --emit-moves (NOTE the v6 naming change: no `130bps` infix); escpod demux detect --method cnn (adapter_rna004@v1.1.0) -> demux basecall --barcodes for the label; bwa mem -C -W13 -k6 -T20 -x ont2d vs resources/ref/eschColi_K_12_MG1655-edx07.fa; leech data prepare --anchor reference (CCAGGC + 2), signal reversed to 5'->3', median/MAD normalised, base-to-signal map refined by banded DP (2 iterations, half-bandwidth 5) against the RNA004 9-mer table; leech model train TCNDwellResidualLN; leech model export --format onnx.

io_contract: THREE float32 inputs, not one: signal [B,2,390] (normalised current and its k-mer residual over [-90,+300) samples about the junction), sequence [B,36,390] (leech.features.encode_signal_kmer of the 11-mer context, scattered along the signal axis -- computed in the dataset, NOT in the graph), features [B,12,21] (per-base dwell and level statistics over reference offsets 0..20). Output [B,1]: a SINGLE BCE logit whose positive class is UNCHARGED, so P(charged) = 1 - sigmoid(logit). Read as P(charged) -- the obvious reading, and what every other variant emits -- every call inverts and nothing errors.
runtime: Loadable by escpod as of 0.19.0. rnabioco/escapepod-rs#308 (closing #306) moved the chunk assembly from leech-core down into escapepod-signal so that both leech and escapepod-classify call one implementation, and escapepod-classify now builds the three tensors itself and runs the graph through tract in the default build; #313 (#312) made the bundle declare where its per-base sequence comes from, and #315 (#314) accepted the `basecaller` block. Releases up to and including 0.18.1 predate all three and refuse this bundle, naming the `gbm`/`feature_model` variants they do implement. THE BAM MUST CARRY MD: the aligned reference this model was trained against is the one MD reconstructs per read, not the FASTA record sliced by coordinate, and a single unresolved ambiguity code blanks NINE consecutive 9-mers.

metrics.source: workflow/rules/charging.smk (charging_leech_train / charging_leech_eval via `leech eval test`, collapsed by workflow/scripts/charging_leech_metrics.py)
metrics.label_source: Per-read LDX barcode call from barcode_crf_nbc16_rna004@v0.3.0, mapped to class by datasets.yaml:label_by_code -- ldx01-10 charged, ldx11-16 uncharged. The caller's error rate is the label-noise floor. The groups are enrichments, not purities: ldx06-10 is spiked and measures ~80% charged by an independent marker, and deacylation during prep converts charged -> uncharged. The operating point in the metrics does NOT rest on these labels; it is derived from ligation chemistry on the two pure blocks.
metrics.split: train/val read-level within Rep_1 (PBK76952, 85/15 at seed 0); test = the whole of Rep_2 (PBK76980), a different flowcell on a different day. The cross-experiment test is the only honest number.

geometry.input: raw signal + sequence k-mer context + per-base features (3 tensors)
geometry.anchor: reference CCAGGC + 2, mapped through the move table; signal reversed to 5'->3'

output_convention.graph_output: a SINGLE BCE logit (N, 1), not a two-class softmax
output_convention.why: leech assigns class ints at merge time and gave `charged` 0 on this corpus. Read as P(charged), every call is inverted and nothing errors.

operating_point.derivation: ligation chemistry, not labels and not another model: ldx01-05 is chemical-ligation-only (100% charged), ldx11-16 enzymatic-only (0% charged). Scored on the cross-experiment test replicate, which this model never saw. A RECOMMENDATION measured on held-out data, not a property of the model -- and precision at any cl depends on the SAMPLE's charged fraction, so a caller wanting a different precision must move it and say so (escapepod-models#63).
operating_point.not_comparable_to: charging_feature_nn_rna004's published cl=200 numbers (FPR 0.0174 / TPR 0.939) are NOT this quantity: they pool both replicates, and they are measured on an UNPURIFIED positive block with a 0.907 purity correction, where this population had those reads dropped before scoring. Use the paired comparison in evidence/ldx16x/charging_paired_subset.json for a like-for-like difference -- same reads, same threshold convention.

calibration.note: post-hoc Platt scaling of the raw logit, learned by `leech model calibrate`. The operating point above is stated on the UNCALIBRATED probability, which is what the graph emits; applying Platt moves the probability scale and therefore the cl that corresponds to a given FPR.

onnx_verification.note: real chunks through LeechDataset, not the exporter's synthetic rows. Says the weights survived export; it does not say a non-Python runtime can build the `sequence` input (escapepod-models#61).

metrics.note: Trained on the natural population (every LDX code, class by datasets.yaml:label_by_code), so the charged class carries the barcode caller's error rate as label noise and ldx06-10's ~20% uncharged content. Test is the other replicate, a different flowcell on a different day, and is the only honest number here: within the training experiment charging and batch are not separable. Numbers on a purity-filtered cohort run ~2 points higher (AUROC 0.9962), but ~95% of that gap is the YARDSTICK -- mislabelled reads leaving the test set -- rather than a better model.

notes: Anchored on the reference CCA|adapter junction, so inference needs an aligned BAM with move tables (dorado --emit-moves) -- the same requirement remora's --reference-anchored and leech's --anchor reference impose, and the same one the shipped GBM and feature networks already carry. The LDX code that supplies the label sits in the RTA adapter, upstream of adapter_end and outside the model's window by construction; edx07 is shared by all 16 codes, so there is no divergent adapter region to leak. Do NOT score this model on the singleadapts edx01/edx02 family: the feature window reaches 20 bases into the 3' adapter, which is safe only because edx07 is constant out to +24, and that family diverges at +17.
